summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (formerly U-Vend Inc.) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2019. This filing concerns the predecessor entity that later renamed itself American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022. It includes Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for 2019 and 2018, reporting net cash provided by financing activities of $338,559 for 2019. However, it does not contain financial statements for the years 2020 through 2024. As the document ends in 2019, it lacks the 2020 baseline and all subsequent years required to establish the trend and calculate the percentage increase for the period specified in the task.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (formerly U-Vend Inc.) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: It provides the net cash provided by financing activities for 2020 ($45,980) in the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. While the company later renamed itself American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022, making this document the 2020 source for the target entity, it only covers the 2020 fiscal year. Consequently, it supplies the initial data point for the trend analysis but lacks the 2021–2024 information required to calculate the 2020-to-2024 percentage increase independently.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: This document contains Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for 2020 ($45,980 net cash provided by financing activities) and 2021 ($477,150). Given that BoxScore Brands, Inc. later renamed to American Battery Materials, Inc., this filing supplies the 2020 and 2021 data points required for the trend analysis, though it lacks the 2022 through 2024 financials needed to calculate the full percentage increase.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc., covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022, which documents the company's subsequent name change to American Battery Materials, Inc. Task-relevant specifics: The Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows report net cash provided by financing activities of $945,000 for 2022 and $477,150 for 2021. This filing provides the 2022 financing inflow figure for the entity that adopted the target name, linking the BoxScore reporting period to the American Battery Materials identity. However, the financial statements presented only cover 2021 and 2022, lacking the 2020 data required for the starting point of the trend, and do not include full-year 2023 or 2024 results, preventing an independent calculation of the 2020-to-2024 percentage increase.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document provides the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for the year ended December 31, 2023, showing $2,349,000 in net cash provided by financing activities, with comparative figures for 2022 ($945,000). It confirms the company's renaming from BoxScore Brands to American Battery Materials effective May 2023. However, the document does not contain financial statements for 2020, 2021, or 2024, so it cannot independently supply the complete trend or percentage increase required from 2020 to 2024.
